name: Fandral's Message
summary: Across the sea, Fandral's Message carries news from Darnassus to Onu in Darkshore. The sealed dispatch concerns Oracle Glade in Teldrassil.

sections.title: A Dispatch from the Archdruid
sections.body: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm writes from the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus. His sealed dispatch is addressed to Onu, the Ancient of Lore who dwells in the Grove of the Ancients. Reports about Oracle Glade in Teldrassil have reached Fandral, so he sends a courier south of Auberdine with word for Onu. The journey crosses the waters to Darkshore, from the new World Tree to Kalimdor’s older, shadowed mainland.

sections.title: Contrasting Tempos
sections.body: Onu says Fandral is always in a hurry. The Ancient of Lore believes affairs should unfold at nature’s own pace, as the ancients believe. To Darkshore’s slow-living treants, Fandral’s haste stands apart from the patient wisdom once shown by Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage.

faq.answer: Fandral's Message carries a sealed dispatch from Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm to Onu, the Ancient of Lore in Darkshore's Grove of the Ancients.

faq.q: Who sends this message and why?
faq.answer: Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm writes from Darnassus after receiving reports about Oracle Glade in Teldrassil. He sends word to Onu in Darkshore.

faq.q: Where does this message need to go?
faq.answer: Carry the message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in Darkshore, directly south of Auberdine.

faq.q: What does Onu think of the letter?
faq.answer: Onu says Fandral is always in a hurry. The Ancient observes that nature moves at its own pace, a truth Shan'do Malfurion Stormrage understood better.

angles.text: As a druid, carrying a message between Darnassus's Cenarion Enclave and the Ancients of Lore in Darkshore shows the divide between Fandral Staghelm’s drive and the older guardians’ patience.
As a night elf, this dispatch takes you from Teldrassil’s crown toward the ancestral forests of Kalimdor’s mainland.
